mechanism_claim: False-positive B0 picks occur when price is moderately extended above the 50-day moving average (px_vs_ma50 in 0.07-0.12 range) while internal momentum quality is mediocre (up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.55). This creates an unstable equilibrium where the stock has drifted up enough to trigger a breakout signal but lacks the sustained internal strength to survive the inevitable pullback near the buy point. Winners show px_vs_ma50 > 0.12 with up_day_ratio_20 ≥ 0.60, giving them structural altitude to absorb pullbacks without violating stop-loss geometry.

Pullback depth alone is not predictive: entity_3adc078f01 had -42.3% pullback but won; entity_8f0df3d38e had -16.2% pullback but ruined. The critical variable is price altitude relative to MAs at entry, not pullback magnitude.
falsifiable_predictions: In a forward B0 sample, stocks with px_vs_ma50 < 0.08 AND up_day_ratio_20 ≤ 0.55 will have >60% false-positive-ruin rate versus baseline B0 ruin rate
Stocks with px_vs_ma50 > 0.15 AND up_day_ratio_20 ≥ 0.60 will have <15% false-positive-ruin rate versus baseline

The zone px_vs_ma50 ∈ [0.08, 0.15] AND up_day_ratio_20 ∈ [0.55, 0.65] will show non-linear ruin probability, higher than both the low-extension and high-extension zones, confirming the unstable-equilibrium hypothesis
vol_ratio_5_20 will NOT independently predict false-positive-ruin within px_vs_ma50/up_day_ratio_20 strata (mechanism is structural, not volatility-driven)
If a snapshot shows ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct > 0.06 AND the two core predictors are in the danger zone, ruin probability should exceed 70%
policy_implications: Add px_vs_ma50 and up_day_ratio_20 as mandatory pre-trade filters; reject B0 picks when both are in the moderate-weak zone
Do NOT use vol_ratio_5_20 as a filter for this failure mode—it is a confound, not a cause

Consider a three-tier classification: (1) structural winners: px_vs_ma50 > 0.15, up_day_ratio > 0.60 → proceed; (2) unstable zone: px_vs_ma50 0.08-0.15, up_day_ratio 0.55-0.65 → require additional confirmation; (3) structural losers: px_vs_ma50 < 0.08 or up_day_ratio < 0.55 → auto-reject or reduce position size
For existing positions near buy points, if px_vs_ma50 drops below 0.08 while up_day_ratio falls below 0.55, tighten stops preemptively—this is a PIT-observable deterioration pattern
Pullback_duration_weeks and pullback_pct should NOT be used at snapshot time to predict ruin—they are post-entry labels. Use only pre-entry structural metrics.

The ibd_entry_close_vs_trigger_pct threshold of ~0.07 appears in multiple ruin cases (entity_8f0df3d38e: 0.069, entity_4fdc3699fd: 0.069, entity_84824e6a20: 0.074, entity_40ea0cfb3b: 0.061)—consider combining this with the structural metrics as a composite filter
